# pdf.js (vendored)

Copies of `pdf.min.mjs` and `pdf.worker.min.mjs` from [pdfjs-dist](https://www.npmjs.com/package/pdfjs-dist) 6.4.299,
licensed Apache-2.0 (see `LICENSE`). They are only loaded when someone uploads a PDF, so they cost nothing otherwise.

To update: `npm install pdfjs-dist`, copy the same two files from `node_modules/pdfjs-dist/build/`, update the version above.
